justify;"><span leaf="">之前</span><span style="color: rgb(4, 120, 87);text-decoration: underline;text-underline-offset: 3px;"><span leaf=""><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" target="_blank" style="color: rgb(4, 120, 87); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px;" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA5OTIzMTE1OA==&amp;mid=2247483955&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=9339df731542c82a96a807c04955c3b4&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" linktype="text" data-linktype="2">采访 Aivilization 团队</a></span></span><span leaf="">时，他们复现过斯坦福小镇，说思路很棒，但“</span><span style="color: rgb(17, 24, 39);font-weight: 700;"><span leaf="">做成实时游戏的成本太高</span></span><span leaf="">”。上线以后，AI 居民更是“</span><span style="color: rgb(17, 24, 39);font-weight: 700;"><span leaf="">每分每秒都在吃算力饭</span></span><span leaf="">”。</span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">一个演示里的居民，走几步、说几句话，就能让人眼前一亮。一座持续运行的小镇却不一样，</span><span style="color: rgb(17, 24, 39);font-weight: 700;"><span leaf="">每个居民每天都要做很多决定</span></span><span leaf="">：几点出门，去哪家店，回不回邻居的消息。这些决定要是都交给大模型，</span><span style="background: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 58%, rgb(252, 231, 166) 58%);padding: 0px 2px;font-weight: 600;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">每一步都会烧掉不少钱</span></span><span leaf="">。</span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size:
